description: This file defines the Git::SVN::Log package, implementing SVN log handling integrated with Git. It includes functions for fetching logs, formatting dates, showing commits, and interacting with external commands like `git` and `svn`.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Log
classes.description: A package for handling SVN logs within a Git context, providing functions to retrieve and display commit logs, blame annotations, and related metadata.

methods.name: cmt_showable
methods.description: Determines if a commit is showable based on its revision and log message length.

methods.name: log_use_color
methods.description: Checks if colored output should be used based on configuration and repository settings.

methods.name: git_svn_log_cmd
methods.description: Constructs the command to fetch SVN logs from Git repositories, considering revision ranges and filters.

methods.name: config_pager
methods.description: Configures the pager program for displaying logs, based on environment and configuration.

methods.name: run_pager
methods.description: Executes the configured pager program in a subprocess for displaying output.

methods.name: format_svn_date
methods.description: Formats SVN commit dates into human-readable strings with timezone considerations.

methods.name: parse_git_date
methods.description: Parses Git-supplied date strings and applies timezone offsets.

methods.name: set_local_timezone
methods.description: Sets the local timezone environment variable based on internal configuration.

methods.name: tz_to_s_offset
methods.description: Converts a timezone string (e.g., +0200) to seconds offset.

methods.name: get_author_info
methods.description: Extracts and records author information from log entries.

methods.name: process_commit
methods.description: Processes and filters commit data based on revision range and display limits.

methods.name: show_commit
methods.description: Displays a commit in either compact or detailed format.

methods.name: show_commit_normal
methods.description: Displays a detailed commit log message, including metadata and changed paths.

methods.name: show_commit_changed_paths
methods.description: Outputs changed paths associated with a commit.

methods.name: cmd_show_log
methods.description: Main function to process Git SVN log command, fetches, parses, and displays commit logs.

methods.name: cmd_blame
methods.description: Performs blame annotation on a file, showing commit revisions and authorship.
